description: This file contains unit tests for the ExistsNode class in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing its constructors, equality/hashcode behavior, and visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: ExistsNodeTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ExistsNode class functionalities, including constructor validation, equality, and visitor pattern.

methods.description: Tests that ExistsNode correctly implements equality and hashcode based on class type.

methods.description: Tests that the ExistsNode constructor sets the property correctly.
